en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa Bin Ubeyd, from Yunus, from Muhammad Bin Muzarab,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The one who accuses his wife before he copulates with her would be whipped one Penalty (Hadd), and she would (still) be his wife’.
